sos.nebraska.gov.es: la Secretaría de Estado de Nebraska

lancaster.ne.gov.es: la Comisión Electoral del Condado de Lancaster (Election Commissioner)

reg_deadline.en: Online and mail registration closed October 16. You can still register in person at your county election office until 6 p.m. on Friday, October 23, 2026.
reg_deadline.es: El registro en línea y por correo cerró el 16 de octubre. Todavía puedes registrarte en persona en la oficina electoral de tu condado hasta las 6 p. m. del viernes 23 de octubre de 2026.
reg_deadline.quote: At 6 PM - last day for in-person voter registration. §32-302
reg_deadline.en_after: Registration closed at 6 p.m. on October 23, 2026. Became a U.S. citizen after that? You can still register and vote at your county election office until 7 p.m. Central (6 p.m. Mountain) on Election Day. Not sure you're registered? Check Votercheck.
reg_deadline.es_after: El registro cerró a las 6 p. m. del 23 de octubre de 2026. ¿Obtuviste la ciudadanía de EE. UU. después de esa fecha? Todavía puedes registrarte y votar en la oficina electoral de tu condado hasta las 7 p. m., hora del Centro (6 p. m., hora de la Montaña), el Día de las Elecciones. ¿No sabes si estás registrado? Revisa en Votercheck.
reg_deadline.quote2: 7 PM CT (6 PM MT) - Deadline for a person who becomes a naturalized citizen after the close of voter registration to register to vote and subsequently vote. §32-942.01

mail_request.en: Your county election office must receive your early voting application by 6 p.m. on Friday, October 23, 2026. Mail, fax or email a photo of the signed form.
mail_request.es: La oficina electoral de tu condado debe recibir tu solicitud para votar por anticipado a más tardar a las 6 p. m. del viernes 23 de octubre de 2026. Mándala por correo, por fax o por email con una foto del formulario firmado.
mail_request.quote: At 6 PM - last day to receive an application for early voting ballots to be mailed out to a specific address. §32-941
mail_request.en_after: Applications for a mailed ballot closed at 6 p.m. on October 23, 2026. You can still vote early in person at your county election office through Monday, November 2. Can't get there? Someone you name as your agent can pick up a ballot for you until 7 p.m. Central (6 p.m. Mountain) on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes de boleta por correo cerraron a las 6 p. m. del 23 de octubre de 2026. Todavía puedes votar por anticipado en persona en la oficina electoral de tu condado hasta el lunes 2 de noviembre. ¿No puedes ir? Una persona que nombres como tu agente puede recoger una boleta por ti hasta las 7 p. m., hora del Centro (6 p. m., hora de la Montaña), el Día de las Elecciones.
mail_request.quote2: 7 PM CT (6 PM MT) - Deadline for agent to pick up early voting ballot. §32-943 Before 1 hour prior to the closing of the polls
mail_request.notes: Neb. Rev. Stat. 32-943: the agent requests the ballot in writing with the voter's ID, may act for no more than two voters, and the ballot must be returned by the time polls close.

mail_return.en: Get it to your county election office by 8 p.m. Central (7 p.m. Mountain) on Tuesday, November 3. A postmark isn't enough: it has to arrive by then, so if time is short, use a drop box in your county or bring it in.
mail_return.es: Hazla llegar a la oficina electoral de tu condado a más tardar a las 8 p. m. hora del Centro (7 p. m. hora de la Montaña) del martes 3 de noviembre. No basta con el matasellos: tiene que llegar para esa hora, así que si tienes poco tiempo, usa un buzón de entrega de tu condado o llévala en persona.
mail_return.quote: All Early Voting ballots, whether personally delivered, delivered by agent, delivered by mail or other carriers must arrive at the county election official's office by the closing of the polls on Election Day (8:00 pm Central Time / 7:00 pm Mountain Time).

early_hours.en: Each county election office sets its own hours for early voting. Call yours before you go.
early_hours.es: Cada oficina electoral de condado fija su propio horario de votación anticipada. Llama a la tuya antes de ir.
early_hours.quote: Contact your County Clerk or Election Commissioner for information on their office hours.

cure.notes: No mail ballot signature cure process or deadline found on sos.nebraska.gov. The Tuesday-after deadline (November 10) is for showing photo ID after a provisional ballot; it is in id.without.

in_person.en: On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place. Eleven counties vote entirely by mail: Boone, Cedar, Cherry, Clay, Dawes, Dixon, Garden, Knox, Merrick, Morrill and Stanton. There your ballot comes in the mail, and you can still vote in person at the county election office on Election Day.
in_person.es: El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde. Once condados votan solo por correo: Boone, Cedar, Cherry, Clay, Dawes, Dixon, Garden, Knox, Merrick, Morrill y Stanton. Ahí tu boleta te llega por correo, y todavía puedes votar en persona en la oficina electoral del condado el Día de las Elecciones.
in_person.quote: Voters in by-mail precincts who wish to vote in-person may vote at their county election official's office on Election Day.

rule.en: Votercheck shows your assigned polling place. You can also ask your county clerk or election commissioner. Early voting in person happens at your county election office.
rule.es: Votercheck muestra el lugar de votación que te corresponde. También puedes preguntarle al secretario o comisionado electoral de tu condado (county clerk o election commissioner). La votación anticipada en persona se hace en la oficina electoral de tu condado.
rule.quote: Each voter must cast his/her ballot at his/her assigned polling place.

en: Nebraska state ID from the DMV
Nebraska college ID, public or private
ID from a Nebraska state, county, city, public school or other political subdivision
A record with your name and photo from a hospital, assisted-living facility, nursing home, hospice, developmental disabilities services agency or intermediate care facility
es: Identificación estatal de Nebraska del DMV
Identificación de un colegio o universidad de Nebraska, público o privado
Identificación del estado, un condado, una ciudad, una escuela pública u otra subdivisión política de Nebraska

Un registro con tu nombre y foto de un hospital, un centro de vida asistida, un asilo de ancianos (nursing home), un hospicio, una agencia de servicios para discapacidades del desarrollo o un centro de cuidados intermedios
accepted.quote: Hospital, assisted-living facility, nursing home, hospice, home and community-based developmental disabilities services agency, or intermediate skilled care facility record that contains the voter’s name and photo.

expired.en: Your ID can be expired. It needs your name and photo, but not an address or an expiration date.
expired.es: Tu identificación puede estar vencida. Debe tener tu nombre y tu foto, pero no necesita dirección ni fecha de vencimiento.
expired.quote: ID must have your name and photo. ID can be expired.

without.en: Bring the ID itself. A photo of it on your phone or a photocopy won't work at the polls. Forgot it? Go home and get it before polls close, or vote a provisional ballot and show your ID in person at your county election office by Tuesday, November 10. If a disability, illness, a religious objection to being photographed, or documents you can't get without real difficulty or expense keep you from getting an ID, fill out a Reasonable Impediment Certification.
without.es: Lleva la identificación original. Una foto en tu teléfono o una fotocopia no sirve en el lugar de votación. ¿Se te olvidó? Ve a casa por ella antes de que cierre la votación, o vota con una boleta provisional y muestra tu identificación en persona en la oficina electoral de tu condado a más tardar el martes 10 de noviembre. Si una discapacidad, una enfermedad, una objeción religiosa a que te tomen fotos o documentos que no puedes conseguir sin mucha dificultad o gasto te impiden obtener una identificación, llena una certificación de impedimento razonable (Reasonable Impediment Certification).
without.quote: The voter will still be able to cast their vote, but their ballot will only count if the voter presents an acceptable form of ID to their county election office, in person, on or before the Tuesday following the election.
without.quote2: Can a voter show a photocopy or an image of their photo ID on their phone to an election official in person rather than presenting the original photo ID? No, the voter must present the original photo ID to vote, whether that’s at the polls, early in person at the election office

who.en: Any registered Nebraska voter can vote early by mail. You don't need a reason.
who.es: Cualquier votante registrado en Nebraska puede votar por anticipado por correo. No necesitas dar una razón.
who.quote: Nebraska is a “no-excuse” state, meaning any registered voter may request an early-voting (absentee) ballot, and is not required to provide a reason.

witness.en: Seal and sign the return envelope. If someone helped you mark your ballot, that person signs it too. In a vote-by-mail county, also write your Nebraska driver's license or state ID number on the envelope, or put a copy of your photo ID or Reasonable Impediment Certification inside.
witness.es: Cierra y firma el sobre de devolución. Si alguien te ayudó a marcar tu boleta, esa persona también lo firma. En un condado que vota por correo, escribe también en el sobre el número de tu licencia de conducir o identificación estatal de Nebraska, o mete una copia de tu identificación con foto o de tu certificación de impedimento razonable (Reasonable Impediment Certification).
witness.quote: The envelope must be sealed and signed (or their mark made) by the voter and if assistance was provided by the person providing assistance.
witness.quote2: Voting in by-mail precincts or by-mail special elections : Write driver's license or state ID number on the ballot return envelope OR enclose a photocopy of acceptable form of ID OR enclose a photocopy of reasonable impediment certification (sos.nebraska.gov/elections/voter-id, read 2026-10-28)

dropbox.en: Every Nebraska county has at least one secure drop box. Use one in your own county by 8 p.m. Central (7 p.m. Mountain) on Election Day.
dropbox.es: Cada condado de Nebraska tiene al menos un buzón de entrega seguro. Usa uno de tu propio condado a más tardar a las 8 p. m. hora del Centro (7 p. m. hora de la Montaña) del Día de las Elecciones.
dropbox.quote: If you wish to return your early voting ballot via drop box, you must use a drop box located within your county.

gear.en: Leave the campaign buttons, hats and shirts at home. Bringing anything with a candidate's name, likeness or logo, or a ballot measure's number or title, into the polling place on Election Day is against the law. No campaigning or handing out political literature within 200 feet, either.
gear.es: Deja en casa los botones, gorras y camisetas de campaña. Es ilegal llevar al lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones cualquier cosa con el nombre, la imagen o el logo de un candidato, o con el número o el título de una propuesta de la boleta. Tampoco se permite hacer campaña ni repartir propaganda política a menos de 200 pies.
gear.quote: Bringing buttons, hats, pencils, pens, shirts, signs, or stickers containing a candidate's name, likeness, logo, symbol or a ballot measure's number, title, subject matter, logo, or symbol into the polling place on Election Day is against the law.

phone.notes: No phone or device rule found on sos.nebraska.gov. Statute 32-1527 lets a voter photograph and share their own marked ballot; that answer is already in the selfie FAQ.

line.en: In line when polls close? Stay in line. Anyone at the polling place or in line at closing time gets to vote.
line.es: ¿Estás en la fila cuando cierran? Quédate en la fila. Cualquier persona que esté en el lugar de votación o en la fila a la hora del cierre puede votar.
line.quote: If at the hour of closing there are any persons desiring to vote who are in the polling place or in a line at the polling place and who have not been able to vote since appearing at the polling place, the polls shall be kept open reasonably long enough after the hour for closing to allow those present at that hour to vote.

tradition.en: Lancaster County picked new “I Voted” and “Future Voter” stickers in its first sticker contest. Katie Nieland’s winning “I Voted” design has been available since the May 12, 2026 primary.
tradition.es: El condado de Lancaster eligió nuevos stickers de “I Voted” y “Future Voter” en su primer concurso de stickers. El diseño ganador de “I Voted”, de Katie Nieland, está disponible desde la primaria del 12 de mayo de 2026.
tradition.quote: Both stickers will be available beginning with the May 12, 2026, Primary Election.

provisional.en: If your name isn't on the list of registered voters, you have the right to vote a provisional ballot. You may also be asked to vote one if you moved within your county or changed your name. Seven business days after the election, check whether it counted on Votercheck or by calling 1-888-727-0007.
provisional.es: Si tu nombre no está en la lista de votantes registrados, tienes derecho a votar con una boleta provisional. También te pueden pedir que votes con una si te mudaste dentro de tu condado o te cambiaste el nombre. Siete días hábiles después de la elección, revisa si se contó en Votercheck o llamando gratis al 1-888-727-0007.
provisional.quote: They can check seven business days after the election by visiting Votercheck or calling toll free 1-888-727-0007.
provisional.notes: Name-not-on-the-list line: sos.nebraska.gov/accessible-voting, read by curl Oct 30: 'The right to cast a provisional ballot if your name does not appear on the list of registered voters.'

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone at the polling place or in line when polls close gets to vote. Anyone who arrives after closing can't.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Cualquier persona que esté en el lugar de votación o en la fila cuando cierran puede votar. Quien llegue después del cierre ya no puede.
line.quote: No person arriving after the hour when the polls have officially closed shall be entitled to vote.

track.en: Look yourself up on Votercheck to see when your ballot was sent, when it came back and its status.
track.es: Búscate en Votercheck para ver cuándo se envió tu boleta, cuándo la recibieron y en qué estado está.
track.quote: Check the Voter Information Center to track the status of your ballot including when your ballot was sent, returned and its status.

late_mail.en: It may be. Your ballot must reach your county election office by 8 p.m. Central (7 p.m. Mountain) on Tuesday, November 3, and a postmark isn't enough. Instead, bring it to your county election office or put it in your county's secure drop box by then. An agent can deliver it for you.
late_mail.es: Puede que sí. Tu boleta debe llegar a la oficina electoral de tu condado a más tardar a las 8 p. m., hora del Centro (7 p. m., hora de la Montaña), del martes 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no basta. Mejor llévala a la oficina electoral de tu condado o déjala en el buzón seguro de entrega de tu condado antes de esa hora. Un representante (agent) puede entregarla por ti.
late_mail.quote: All Early Voting ballots, whether personally delivered, delivered by agent, delivered by mail or other carriers must arrive at the county election official's office by the closing of the polls on Election Day (8:00 pm Central Time / 7:00 pm Mountain Time). Where can I find my county's secure ballot drop box? Nebraska Drop Box Locator
late_mail.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Postmark: SOS May 2026 reminder 'Ballots which are postmarked on or before Election Day but are not received until after polls close will not be accepted.' (Perplexity lead).

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on sos.nebraska.gov (curl worked): Early Voting, Election Day FAQ, Voter ID, Nebraska Drop Box Locator, the 2026 Official Election Calendar PDF; and nebraskalegislature.gov statutes 32-908 (hours, line), 32-1524 (electioneering, 200 feet), 32-1527 (ballot photo), 32-950.01 (drop boxes). EARLY VOTING vs states.js: states.js has end 2026-11-02 and no start. The calendar gives the start: '5-Oct First day for early voting - in person - at the county clerk or election commissioner office.' and '2-Nov Last day for early voting - in person - at the county clerk or election commissioner office. §32-942'. The provisional photo ID deadline is November 10 per the calendar ('Deadline to present valid photographic identification ... on or before the Tuesday after the election'); id.without says 'the Tuesday after the election'. Phone rule, mail ballot cure, first-time voter rules and a sticker tradition on an official page were not found; left missing.

hours.en: Polls are open 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. in Central time and 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. in Mountain time.
hours.es: Se vota de 8 a. m. a 8 p. m. en la hora del Centro y de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m. en la hora de la Montaña.
hours.quote: At all elections in the area of this state lying within the Mountain Standard or Mountain Daylight time zone, the polls shall open at 7 a.m. and close at 7 p.m. of the same day, and in the area lying within the Central Standard or Central Daylight time zone, the polls shall open at 8 a.m. and close at 8 p.m. of the same day.
